name: Ninefold House: Silent Week (resting)
summary: Silent week for 6 to 8 experienced practitioners in a lay Christian community. Morning and Evening Prayer, nothing else required. Rest is expected. Donation.
description:
Ninefold House is a lay Christian community of six on the edge of the Cambridgeshire fen. We keep the Divine Office and grow much of our own food. Eight times a year we receive six to eight guests for a week of silence.

The week is for people who already have a contemplative practice, whether of prayer or of meditation, and who want a week of it in a settled house without arranging anything themselves. It is not suitable as a first silent retreat, and we do not offer instruction.

**Shape of the day**
Morning Prayer at 7.00 and Evening Prayer at 18.00 in the chapel, each about twenty-five minutes. Guests are asked to attend both. 

**Rest**
Nothing is asked of guests between the Offices. The community does its own garden and estate work; guests are not expected to join in, to walk, or to do anything other than be present. Most guests sleep a good deal in the first days. The library is heated and the chairs are comfortable. The one walk on the property is level and takes twenty minutes. We offer this week because many who come to us are more tired than they have acknowledged, and a week of not being needed is what they require. Those who would prefer to work should book the Working Silent Week.

The remaining hours are unstructured: guests use the chapel, their rooms, the library, and the orchard as they wish.

A member of the community is available between 14.00 and 15.00 each day for anyone who wishes to speak. Otherwise guests are not approached.

**Silence**
Silence is kept from arrival on Saturday afternoon to departure the following Saturday morning, including at meals.

**Meals**
Three vegetarian meals daily, eaten in silence in the refectory.

**Cost**
There is no fixed charge. Guests contribute what they are able; the suggested contribution is £220 for the week.
practical: Saturday 15.00 to the following Saturday 10.00; eight weeks per year. Suggested contribution £220. Six single rooms, one twin. Three vegetarian meals daily. Bring slippers, reading matter, and warm clothing for the chapel. Ely station, twelve miles; bus service limited. No mobile signal indoors.
